brand.name: Underworld Writer
brand.tagline: Build the story. Expose the truth. Ship what matters.
brand.supportingLine: Narrative engine · Editorial tooling · Podcast creation · Real impact

canonicalCover.usage: immutable visual base for README hero, changelog release art, Open Graph cards, repository release notes, and package announcements
rules: Reuse the approved composition as the visual base for every 1200x630 release asset.
Do not redraw the composition from primitive SVG shapes.
Do not substitute a generic mascot, white silhouette, alternate cavern, or generic cyberpunk scene.
Do not regenerate the wordmark, mascot placement, portal placement, card geometry, or footer geometry independently when the canonical artwork is available.
Release-specific version and feature-card copy may be replaced only in the declared dynamic text zones.

visualIdentity.name: Neon Underworld
traits: black and near-black editorial UI field
electric magenta and violet cavern environment
stitched plush voodoo-doll mascot with button eye, stitched mouth, and neon pins
repository footer and OPEN NARRATIVES. REAL CHANGE. signature

immutableRegions: right-side neon portal and cavern focal point

versionBadge.rule: Replace version text while preserving badge geometry and RELEASE label.

featureCards.rule: Replace title and body text only; preserve approved card geometry, icons, spacing, background, and visual hierarchy.

openGraph.strategy: reuse approved base and update dynamic text zones only

readmeHero.strategy: use current generated Open Graph release asset

githubSocial.strategy: contain the generated 1200x630 composition on void background; do not redraw

square.strategy: frame or crop the generated composition while preserving wordmark and mascot; do not redraw

generation.fallback: If Release Artwork metadata is absent, derive up to six concise cards from Added, Changed, and Fixed bullets.
generation.rule: Rock-Hardened owns release evidence; Underworld Writer owns its repository-specific visual renderer and template.

rockHardenedIntegration.visualAuthority: This repository owns the visual composition, template, and dynamic overlay geometry.
rockHardenedIntegration.prohibition: Do not modify Fused-Gaming/rock-hardened to change Underworld Writer release styling.

requirements: Read this file before generating release artwork.
Use the approved raster template; never approximate it with hand-drawn primitive SVG scenery.
Change only the declared dynamic text zones when rendering a new release.
Populate release cards from the current CHANGELOG.md release section.
Run npm run release:art after changing release version or Release Artwork metadata.
Never modify Rock-Hardened solely to change Underworld Writer styling.
